result.verdict: PASS — all checks satisfied. Test is a genuine regression discriminator.

A_covers_right_scenario.detail: Test calls Attachments.get_content/3 (3-arity: id, instance_b, prefix: schema). It uses a cross-instance-same-tenant scenario: attachment uploaded for instance_a, then called with instance_b in the SAME tenant schema. Not a cross-tenant scenario. Correct target.

B_assertion_specific.detail: Negative assertion: == {:error, :not_found} (exact match, not a generic 'not :ok' check). Positive case also tested: {:ok, ^attachment, _artifact} for the owning instance_a. Both arms exercised.

C_fail_first_credibility.detail: Pre-fix code has get_content/2 (no instance_id parameter). Calling get_content/3 raises UndefinedFunctionError at runtime — a genuine test failure (exit 1). TEST-DESIGNER reported 4/24 failures (all 4 tests calling get_content/3). Credible. Per WF-03 procedure for the 'code did not exist' case, an independent mutant was also required and is reported below.

D_mutation_proof.mutant_applied: Removed :ok <- check_instance_match(attachment, instance_id) from get_content/3's with chain, leaving only get(id, opts) -> check_scan_status_clean -> Repo.get(Artifact, ...).
D_mutation_proof.tdv_measured_result: elixir -S mix test test/letflow/repository/attachments_test.exs --seed 0 exited 1. Result: 23/24 passed, Failed: 1 test. The 1 failure is test/letflow/repository/attachments_test.exs:643 — the ISS-0785 assertion. Actual: {:ok, attachment, artifact}; expected: {:error, :not_found}. The artifact WAS retrieved (content: 'hello attachment bytes' visible in diff output), confirming the mutation causes a real false-pass in the pre-mutant state.
D_mutation_proof.revert_check: git diff --stat lib/letflow/repository/attachments.ex produced no output (file exactly matches committed state). Post-revert run: 24/24 passed.
D_mutation_proof.note: TEST-DESIGNER's reported mutation counts (23/24, 1 failure) match TDV's independently measured counts exactly.

E_acceptance_criteria_coverage.detail: ISS-0785.yaml has no formal acceptance_criteria key. The issue's core requirement (described in 'description' and 'suggested_fix') is: cross-instance-same-tenant denial must happen before the artifact blob read, at 1 round-trip cost, returning {:error, :not_found}. The test covers: (1) cross-instance-same-tenant denial returns {:error, :not_found} [negative path], (2) owning-instance access succeeds [positive path / regression guard]. The timing/round-trip invariant is structural in the fix itself (check_instance_match in with chain before Repo.get(Artifact, ...)) and is implicitly validated by the passing negative path (if the blob read fired before the instance check, the test would pass only if the artifact lookup happened to fail — which it doesn't, as the mutation proof confirms). Full coverage of the issue's stated requirement.

F_test_isolation.detail: Test provisions its own tenant with unique slug 'iss0785-cross-instance'. Creates fresh UUIDs for instance_a and instance_b. Calls Attachments.upload/2 to create its own attachment row. No shared global state, no dependency on prior test runs. Self-contained.

G_no_skip_tags.detail: No @tag :skip on any ISS-0785 test. No 'TODO: implement test' left in spec.

H_no_hardcoded_secrets.detail: No hardcoded credentials or connection strings. Fixtures use Ecto.UUID.generate() and hardcoded benign test content ('hello attachment bytes').

result.summary: The ISS-0785 regression test is correctly structured, specifically asserts {:error, :not_found} on cross-instance-same-tenant denial, also validates the positive path, is fully isolated, and is a genuine discriminator. TDV independently applied the check_instance_match mutant and measured 23/24 (1 failure at line 643) — confirming the test catches the exact defect it targets. Post-revert: 24/24 pass.
